set.inbound.signingTycho: Include three headers on each request: {eventHeader} (event ID, stable across retries), {timeHeader} (signing time, UTC epoch seconds), and {sigHeader}. To target a project, include {projectHeader} (project ID shown beside each allowed project); it is included in the signature. Signature = lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, "{version}" + newline + timestamp + newline + event_id + newline + project_id + newline + raw_body); use an empty string for project_id when the project header is omitted.
set.inbound.signingGithub: Add a webhook in repository Settings using the delivery URL above, set Content type to application/json, and paste this secret. Each request includes {sigHeader} (sha256= plus HMAC-SHA256 of the body), {deliveryHeader} (delivery ID), and {eventHeader} (event type). GitHub does not sign timestamps; duplicate delivery IDs are ignored during the deduplication window.
set.inbound.signingStandardWebhooks: Integrate using the Standard Webhooks v1 spec: configure the delivery URL above and this whsec_ secret in your sender (such as a cluster alert channel or standard SDK). Each request must include {idHeader}, {timeHeader} (UTC epoch seconds), and {sigHeader} (v1,<base64>, HMAC-SHA256 over "<id>.<timestamp>.<raw_body>"). Because Standard Webhooks v1 signatures do not include a project header, each source routes directly to its single allowed project.

set.item.router.cli.title: Router CLI path
set.item.router.cli.help: Automatically locates the matching executor CLI (Claude / Codex / Gemini) when left empty, searching PATH first and then common install directories. Falls back and warns in health checks if a configured path disappears. Takes effect on next Router start — click "Restart Router" below.
set.item.router.cli.empty: Auto-detect executor CLI: PATH first, then common user install paths
set.item.router.account.title: Router account
set.item.router.account.help: Determines which executor and login the Router uses. Machine logins must reside on this host. Leave empty to use this host's Claude login and default tier. Takes effect on next Router start — click "Restart Router" below.
set.item.router.account.empty: Unbound: use this host's own login and default tier
set.item.router.tier.title: Router tier
set.item.router.tier.help: Which tier of the bound account the Router runs on. Only applies when an account is bound; leave empty for the executor's default tier. Takes effect on next Router start — click "Restart Router" below.
set.item.router.directReadyNotice.title: Direct verification-ready notifications
set.item.router.directReadyNotice.help: When you explicitly ask for a verification run to notify you directly upon completion, Tycho pushes a ready-for-review notice immediately once no follow-up work remains. Turn off to route settlement through the Router.
set.item.router.turnTimeoutMs.title: Router turn timeout
set.item.router.turnTimeoutMs.help: Maximum time the Router may spend handling one message before being interrupted (measured after the Router process is ready, excluding startup). Applies starting from the next turn.
set.item.router.startTimeoutMs.title: Router startup timeout
set.item.router.startTimeoutMs.help: Maximum time to wait for a newly spawned Router process to report ready before terminating it and marking the message unverified (without auto-retrying). Increase if your executor starts slowly. Applies on next launch.
set.item.router.interruptGraceMs.title: Router interrupt grace period
set.item.router.interruptGraceMs.help: Time to wait for the Router to finish gracefully after an interrupt or turn timeout before terminating its process. Applies on next interrupt.
set.item.router.idleMs.title: Router idle exit timeout
set.item.router.idleMs.help: Project Router processes exit after sitting idle for this duration and respawn automatically on the next message. Lower saves memory; higher avoids respawn latency. Applies after the next turn.
set.item.router.contextTokens.title: Router context rotation threshold (tokens)
set.item.router.contextTokens.help: When a project Router's context reaches this token count, start a fresh context rebuilt from the ledger before the next message while keeping the same visible conversation. Set to 0 to disable automatic rotation.
set.item.router.materialKb.title: Router recovery brief limit (KB)
set.item.router.materialKb.help: Maximum size (KB) of the ledger recovery brief injected when a project Router rotates to a fresh context. Overflow items remain accessible via tools listed in the brief.
set.item.models.refreshMs.title: Model catalog refresh interval
set.item.models.refreshMs.help: How often the service queries executors for each account's available models (also refreshed on save, login change, and Test connection). Falls back to the last known list on failure.
set.item.accounts.loginTimeoutMs.title: Console account login timeout
set.item.accounts.loginTimeoutMs.help: Maximum time allowed for an interactive account sign-in flow (from start through authorization code submission and initial tier setup) before expiring.
set.item.accounts.loginCleanupMs.title: Login process exit grace period
set.item.accounts.loginCleanupMs.help: Maximum time to wait for spawned login helper processes to exit after a login flow completes, fails, cancels, or times out.
set.item.accounts.loginSettleMs.title: Login token output settle window
set.item.accounts.loginSettleMs.help: How long to wait for screen output to settle after Claude prints a token before capturing it, preventing partial token capture over slow connections.
set.item.accounts.expiryRemindDays.title: Login expiry reminder lead time (days)
set.item.accounts.expiryRemindDays.help: Remind via health checks and notifications this many days before an account's estimated 1-year token expiry date. Sent once per token.
set.item.accounts.signInPollMs.title: Machine login progress poll interval
set.item.accounts.signInPollMs.help: How frequently a machine reports interactive login progress (URL, user code, completion) back to the host while a login helper is running.
set.item.quota.readStaleMs.title: Quota reading staleness threshold
set.item.quota.readStaleMs.help: When opening Usage, accounts with quota readings older than this threshold run a minimal probe on the host to refresh remaining quota. Set to 0 to probe only on manual Refresh.
set.item.quota.readTimeoutMs.title: Quota probe timeout
set.item.quota.readTimeoutMs.help: Maximum time to wait for a single account quota probe before giving up and retaining the previous reading.
set.item.node.pollHoldMs.title: Machine command long-poll hold duration
set.item.node.pollHoldMs.help: Maximum time the server holds a machine's command poll open waiting for work. Default leaves margin below typical 60s proxy/LB idle timeouts.
set.item.node.commandTimeoutMs.title: Machine command timeout
set.item.node.commandTimeoutMs.help: Maximum time to wait for a machine command (snapshot, launch, status, output read) before treating the response as unknown without re-launching.
set.item.node.joinTtlMs.title: Machine admission request TTL
set.item.node.joinTtlMs.help: How long a machine's 6-digit join code remains valid for approval and token pickup before requiring a new join command.
set.item.node.endedJoinKeepMs.title: Completed join request memory duration
set.item.node.endedJoinKeepMs.help: How long approved, rejected, or expired join requests are remembered in memory so repeated approval clicks report accurate status.
set.item.node.endedJoinMax.title: Max completed join requests remembered
set.item.node.endedJoinMax.help: Maximum number of completed join requests kept in memory alongside the retention duration; oldest entries are evicted first.
set.item.node.materialTtlMs.title: Ephemeral join material TTL
set.item.node.materialTtlMs.help: Validity period of one-time join credentials issued to tasks that spawn temporary worker machines without manual admission.
set.item.node.inviteTtlMs.title: Machine invite quota TTL
set.item.node.inviteTtlMs.help: Maximum lifetime of a Router-requested machine invite slot during which launched rounds may receive join material.
set.item.node.inviteMaxMachines.title: Max machines per invite quota
set.item.node.inviteMaxMachines.help: Upper limit on how many machines a single Router-requested invite slot may register.
set.item.node.gapSlackMs.title: Online grace window between polls
set.item.node.gapSlackMs.help: Allowed gap between consecutive machine polls before marking the machine offline and its active runs disconnected. Increase for high-latency or proxied links.
set.item.node.outputStoreLimitMb.title: Machine pending output budget (MiB)
set.item.node.outputStoreLimitMb.help: Total budget for retained machine outputs awaiting upload (not total disk/RAM). Lowering keeps existing results and pauses new reservations until under budget.
set.item.node.runOutputLimitMb.title: Per-round raw output retention (MiB)
set.item.node.runOutputLimitMb.help: Per-round retention budget across stdout/stderr streams; trims older output while keeping bounded tail segments without stopping the worker.
set.item.node.resultLimitMb.title: Per-round native result limit (MiB)
set.item.node.resultLimitMb.help: Maximum parsed state and result payload size per round. Exceeding marks the round unverified for manual review rather than auto-retrying.
set.item.node.executorRefreshMs.title: Machine executor re-probe interval
set.item.node.executorRefreshMs.help: How often machines re-scan installed executors, versions, logins, and read-only support. Click "Test connection" on Machines to trigger immediately.
set.item.node.modelListTimeoutMs.title: Machine model-list probe timeout
set.item.node.modelListTimeoutMs.help: Timeout for querying an executor's supported models on a machine (separate from the 6s timeout used by lighter probes).
set.item.node.quotaReadTimeoutMs.title: Machine local-login quota probe timeout
set.item.node.quotaReadTimeoutMs.help: Timeout for background quota checks on a machine's own local logins (e.g. Claude Code /usage can take ~55s). Runs in background without blocking executor reports.
set.item.node.releaseCheckMs.title: Machine agent release check interval
set.item.node.releaseCheckMs.help: How often machines check the host's running version and auto-upgrade themselves when idle with no active runs or logins.
set.item.machine.cooldownMs.title: Unreachable machine retry cooldown
set.item.machine.cooldownMs.help: How long to skip dispatching new rounds (and pause cleanup sweeps) to a machine that failed to respond.
set.item.machine.probeFreshMs.title: Recent machine response cache window
set.item.machine.probeFreshMs.help: Skip pre-dispatch health probing for a machine that already responded within this window.
set.item.machine.sweepMs.title: Finished run cleanup interval
set.item.machine.sweepMs.help: How often the service sweeps responsive machines to clean up runs that have already finished in the ledger.
set.item.run.timeoutMs.title: Single run timeout
set.item.run.timeoutMs.help: Maximum duration for a single execution round before interruption. Applies to newly started rounds only.
set.item.run.modelIdleTimeoutMs.title: Model idle stall timeout
set.item.run.modelIdleTimeoutMs.help: Abort a round if it makes no progress for this long while purely waiting on model/init (never triggers while local tools or scripts are actively running). Set to 0 to disable.
set.item.run.lostGraceMs.title: Disconnected machine grace period
set.item.run.lostGraceMs.help: How long a worker machine may remain unreachable before its active run is declared lost and handed over for continuation.
set.item.run.maxLostContinuations.title: Max automatic continuations after loss
set.item.run.maxLostContinuations.help: Stop auto-continuing and wait for you after this many consecutive lost rounds on the same task; resets when you click "Continue".
set.item.quota.restMs.title: Initial quota cooldown duration
set.item.quota.restMs.help: How long an account rests after hitting a quota limit before retrying (unless the executor specifies an exact reset time). Other tasks automatically spill over to alternate accounts.
set.item.quota.maxRestMs.title: Maximum quota cooldown duration
set.item.quota.maxRestMs.help: Upper cap for exponential backoff when an account repeatedly hits quota limits immediately after resting; resets after a successful round.
set.item.quota.warnPercent.title: Soft deprioritization usage threshold (%)
set.item.quota.warnPercent.help: Deprioritize accounts whose reported quota usage reaches this percentage so other accounts are preferred first. Set to 100 to deprioritize only when full.
set.item.dispatch.frontLead.title: Preferred account lead allowance
set.item.dispatch.frontLead.help: How many more concurrent rounds a higher-priority login may hold over the next login in the dispatch order before spilling over. Set high for strict priority ordering.
set.item.dispatch.order.operate.title: Operate tier login priority
set.item.dispatch.order.operate.help: Global preferred login order when dispatching Operate-tier tasks. Listed logins are tried first; unlisted ones follow. Acts as a preference and falls through when full, out of quota, or unreachable.
set.item.dispatch.order.operate.empty: Unordered: default login order (accounts first, then machine logins)
set.item.dispatch.order.execute.title: Execute tier login priority
set.item.dispatch.order.execute.help: Global preferred login order when dispatching Execute-tier tasks. Listed logins are tried first; unlisted ones follow. Acts as a preference and falls through when full, out of quota, or unreachable.
set.item.dispatch.order.execute.empty: Unordered: default login order (accounts first, then machine logins)
set.item.dispatch.order.decide.title: Decide tier login priority
set.item.dispatch.order.decide.help: Global preferred login order when dispatching Decide-tier tasks. Listed logins are tried first; unlisted ones follow. Acts as a preference and falls through when full, out of quota, or unreachable.
set.item.dispatch.order.decide.empty: Unordered: default login order (accounts first, then machine logins)
set.item.site.outputLimitKb.title: Max retained tool output per step (KB)
set.item.site.outputLimitKb.help: Maximum KB kept per tool call output/input/diff in live task views and host diagnostics (keeps head & tail when exceeded without altering raw machine logs).
set.item.site.diagnosticEvents.title: Max diagnostic events per round
set.item.site.diagnosticEvents.help: Maximum number of recent diagnostic events retained on the host per round (bounded alongside the diagnostic size limit); ledger receipts and summaries are unaffected.
set.item.site.diagnosticLimitKb.title: Host diagnostic size limit per round (KiB)
set.item.site.diagnosticLimitKb.help: Maximum total KiB retained in host diagnostic logs per round (bounded alongside the event count limit); oldest entries are trimmed with an explicit gap marker.
set.item.artifacts.fileLimitMb.title: Max single artifact file size (MB)
set.item.artifacts.fileLimitMb.help: Maximum size of an individual non-code artifact fetched from a worker machine after a round completes. Larger files are skipped and noted on the task page.
set.item.artifacts.totalLimitMb.title: Max total artifact size per round (MB)
set.item.artifacts.totalLimitMb.help: Maximum combined size of artifacts fetched in one round. Files that would exceed the budget are skipped while smaller subsequent files are still collected.
set.item.knowledge.briefLimitKb.title: Knowledge budget in round brief (KiB)
set.item.knowledge.briefLimitKb.help: Maximum combined UTF-8 size (KiB) of knowledge bodies and skill indexes embedded in a round's brief. Rounds that exceed this pause clearly rather than silently truncating.
set.item.knowledge.snapshotLimitKb.title: Knowledge & skills budget in snapshot (KiB)
set.item.knowledge.snapshotLimitKb.help: Maximum combined size (KiB) of knowledge and skill files attached to a round's snapshot. Exceeding pauses the round with a clear report.
set.item.knowledge.entryLimitKb.title: Single knowledge entry body limit (KiB)
set.item.knowledge.entryLimitKb.help: Maximum body size (KiB) for a single knowledge entry. Proposals exceeding this limit are rejected.
set.item.knowledge.externalEntry.title: Project global knowledge to external CLI sessions
set.item.knowledge.externalEntry.help: When enabled, machines project always-on global, role-agnostic knowledge into native global instruction files for Claude, Codex, dsh, and Gemini. Tycho-dispatched rounds always read from their own snapshot.
set.item.knowledge.globalEntryLimitKb.he: Maximum body size (KiB) written to each executor's native global instruction file. If exceeded, the projection is withheld rather than partially written.
set.item.knowledge.globalEntryCheckMs.he: How often the host verifies its local executors' projected global knowledge files and repairs missing entries without rewriting unchanged files.
set.item.knowledge.curateAtPercent.title: Auto-curate knowledge threshold (%)
set.item.knowledge.curateAtPercent.help: Automatically creates a knowledge curation task when a project/role's effective knowledge reaches this percentage of the brief or snapshot limit.
set.item.knowledge.logins.title: Allowed logins for knowledge tasks
set.item.knowledge.logins.help: Restricts knowledge review and curation tasks to these logins (leave empty to allow all logins). Ordering follows the global dispatch order for the task's tier.
set.item.knowledge.logins.empty: All your logins can be used
set.item.knowledge.evidenceLimitKb.title: Proposal evidence excerpt limit (KiB)
set.item.knowledge.evidenceLimitKb.help: Maximum combined size (KiB) of evidence excerpts attached to a single knowledge proposal.
set.item.wecom.botId.title: Bot ID
set.item.wecom.botId.help: WeCom Smart Bot ID. Setting this enables WeCom; clearing disables it. Configure Secret and Recipient first. Reconnects immediately on save.
set.item.wecom.owner.title: Recipient
set.item.wecom.owner.help: Your WeCom user ID (userid) that receives notifications and can command Tycho. Automatically added to the WeCom allowlist on first enable.
set.item.wecom.url.title: Gateway URL
set.item.wecom.url.help: WeCom persistent WebSocket gateway URL. Leave empty to use the official gateway. Reconnects immediately on save.
set.item.im.wecom.chat.title: WeCom · Project chat
set.item.im.wecom.chat.help: Allow chatting with project Routers, issuing tasks, and triggering from bound groups via WeCom.
set.item.im.wecom.notify.title: WeCom · Proactive notifications
set.item.im.wecom.notify.help: Allow pushing ready-for-review notices, decision prompts, failure alerts, daily digests, and group broadcasts to WeCom.
set.item.im.wecom.approveLogin.title: WeCom · Approve console sign-in
set.item.im.wecom.approveLogin.help: Allow sending "登录" or "登录 <code>" in a WeCom DM to approve console sign-ins.
set.item.im.weixin.chat.title: WeChat · Project chat
set.item.im.weixin.chat.help: Allow chatting with project Routers, issuing tasks, and triggering from bound groups via WeChat.
set.item.im.weixin.notify.title: WeChat · Proactive notifications
set.item.im.weixin.notify.help: Allow pushing ready-for-review notices, decision prompts, failure alerts, daily digests, and group broadcasts to WeChat (off by default to reduce noise).
set.item.im.weixin.approveLogin.title: WeChat · Approve console sign-in
set.item.im.weixin.approveLogin.help: Allow sending "登录" or "登录 <code>" in a WeChat DM to approve console sign-ins.
set.item.outbox.giveUpAfterMs.title: Notification retry give-up window
set.item.outbox.giveUpAfterMs.help: Stop retrying a failed notification after this long since its first failed delivery attempt.
set.item.outbox.retryFirstMs.title: Initial notification retry delay
set.item.outbox.retryFirstMs.help: Delay before the first retry of a failed notification; doubles on each subsequent failure up to the maximum interval.
set.item.outbox.retryMaxMs.title: Max notification retry interval
set.item.outbox.retryMaxMs.help: Upper cap for exponential backoff between failed notification retries.
set.item.push.remindMs.title: Pending-action reminder interval
set.item.push.remindMs.help: How long to wait before reminding you again about unresolved questions, stalled tasks, expired logins, or pending knowledge proposals.
set.item.push.remindMax.title: Max reminders per item
set.item.push.remindMax.help: Maximum number of follow-up reminders after the initial notification for the same item. Set to 0 to send once with no reminders.
set.item.push.resultWindowMs.title: Project result batching window
set.item.push.resultWindowMs.help: The first completed/merged/released notice for a project is pushed immediately; subsequent results within this window are batched together. Set to 0 to push each individually.
set.item.push.daily.title: Daily digest
set.item.push.daily.help: Send a daily summary grouped by project listing items waiting on you, completed, running, and blocked (skipped if nothing changed).
set.item.push.dailyAt.title: Daily digest time
set.item.push.dailyAt.help: Host local time in 24-hour HH:MM format. If the service is offline at that time, it sends a catch-up digest on next start.
set.item.triggers.graceMs.title: Scheduled trigger on-time grace window
set.item.triggers.graceMs.help: A scheduled trigger firing within this window after its due time counts as on-time; later arrivals follow the trigger's missed-run policy.
set.item.triggers.minIntervalMs.title: Minimum recurring trigger interval
set.item.triggers.minIntervalMs.help: Shortest interval allowed between consecutive runs of fixed-interval and cron triggers, preventing runaway Router quota usage.
set.item.triggers.dedupeKeepMs.title: Event deduplication retention
set.item.triggers.dedupeKeepMs.help: How long duplicate event IDs from the same trigger or inbound source are deduplicated (returning the original receipt if identical, or rejecting if modified).
set.item.triggers.queueMax.title: Max queued trigger events per project
set.item.triggers.queueMax.help: Maximum unread trigger/inbound/internal events queued per project before new ones are rejected (HTTP 429 for inbound callers). Owner messages and coalesced recurring triggers do not count.
set.item.triggers.perTriggerPerMinute.he: Maximum accepted events per minute from a single trigger or inbound source before throttling.
set.item.triggers.perMinute.title: Global trigger/source rate limit (per minute)
set.item.triggers.perMinute.help: Maximum combined events accepted per minute across all triggers and inbound sources to protect Router capacity and quota.
set.item.triggers.dataLimitKb.title: Trigger/inbound payload size limit (KiB)
set.item.triggers.dataLimitKb.help: Maximum size (KiB) of reference payload data carried by a single trigger or inbound event.
set.item.triggers.inboundSkewMs.title: Inbound signature clock-skew tolerance
set.item.triggers.inboundSkewMs.help: Maximum allowed difference between a tycho-v1 request's signing timestamp and this host's clock. Takes effect immediately.
set.item.triggers.inboundRotateMs.title: Rotated inbound key grace period
set.item.triggers.inboundRotateMs.help: How long a rotated inbound signing key remains accepted while callers migrate to the new key. Set to 0 to revoke immediately on rotation.
set.item.triggers.problemAfter.title: Consecutive failures before alerting
set.item.triggers.problemAfter.help: Number of consecutive failures of the same kind before a trigger or inbound source raises a problem alert (resets after any successful acceptance).
set.item.triggers.problemAlertWindowMs.h: Minimum interval between push alerts for repeated signature verification failures on the same inbound source, preventing spam from unauthenticated callers.
set.item.login.linkTtlMs.title: Sign-in link validity
set.item.login.linkTtlMs.help: How long newly generated sign-in links remain usable. Existing links retain the validity they were issued with.
set.item.login.sessionDays.title: Session lifetime (days)
set.item.login.sessionDays.help: How many days a console sign-in session lasts. Lowering immediately expires older sessions.
set.item.login.temporarySessionMs.title: Temporary approval lifetime
set.item.login.temporarySessionMs.help: How long a temporarily approved device session lasts. Applies to newly approved devices.
set.item.login.failWindowMs.title: Failed sign-in rate-limit window
set.item.login.failWindowMs.help: Sliding window for counting invalid gateway sign-in links and new-device requests before temporarily pausing responses. Valid sign-in links are never blocked.
set.item.login.failsPerSource.title: Max failed sign-ins per source
set.item.login.failsPerSource.help: Maximum failed sign-in attempts allowed from one source within the rate-limit window before temporarily pausing replies.
set.item.login.failsTotal.title: Max failed sign-ins across all sources
set.item.login.failsTotal.help: Maximum combined failed sign-in attempts across all sources within the rate-limit window.
set.item.release.healthWindowMs.title: Post-release health observation window
set.item.release.healthWindowMs.help: How long a newly deployed release must stay healthy on the same process before passing verification. Set to 0 to skip observation.
set.item.release.recoveryWaitMs.title: Startup machine inventory wait
set.item.release.recoveryWaitMs.help: How long a new release waits to inventory connected machines during startup verification before continuing in the background.
set.item.release.drainTimeoutMs.title: Pre-release Router drain timeout
set.item.release.drainTimeoutMs.help: How long to wait for active Router turns to finish before stopping the service during a release. Set to 0 to stop immediately.
set.item.http.port.title: HTTP port
set.item.http.port.help: Port the console and API server listen on.
set.item.http.host.title: Listen address
set.item.http.host.help: 127.0.0.1 restricts access to this machine only; 0.0.0.0 allows phones and other devices on your LAN or mesh network to connect.
set.item.http.reverseProxyPort.title: Reverse proxy entry port
set.item.http.reverseProxyPort.help: External entry port bound strictly to 127.0.0.1 for a local HTTPS reverse proxy (set to 0 to disable). Configure Public URL with HTTPS and have your proxy overwrite X-Forwarded-For. Requires restart.
set.item.http.publicUrl.title: Public URL
set.item.http.publicUrl.help: Base URL used by phones and other devices to open the console (e.g. http://10.0.0.5:8787 or your HTTPS gateway origin). Used in sign-in and notification links. Origin only — no path, credentials, query, or hash.
set.item.gateway.ssh.title: Gateway SSH host
set.item.gateway.ssh.help: Externally reachable SSH host you control (user@host or user@host:port). Setting establishes a persistent SSH reverse tunnel; clearing disables it. Requires passwordless SSH login and an HTTPS Public URL. Reconnects immediately on save.
set.item.gateway.wss.title: Gateway 443 WebSocket tunnel
set.item.gateway.wss.help: Optional WebSocket URL (e.g. wss://gw.example.com/_gateway) forwarding to sshd over port 443 when TCP 22 is blocked. Leave empty to connect directly over SSH. Reconnects immediately on save.
set.item.gateway.keyFile.title: Gateway SSH private key
set.item.gateway.keyFile.help: Path to the SSH private key for connecting to the gateway host. Leave empty to use the service user's default SSH config and keys. Reconnects immediately on save.
set.item.gateway.keyFile.empty: Use this service user's default SSH config and keys
set.item.gateway.remotePort.title: Gateway remote port
set.item.gateway.remotePort.help: Loopback port (127.0.0.1) on the gateway host receiving forwarded traffic from its reverse proxy. Reconnects immediately on save.
set.item.gateway.localPort.title: Gateway local entry port
set.item.gateway.localPort.help: Loopback port (127.0.0.1) on this host serving gateway-forwarded requests (console pages and authenticated APIs only; local-only admin routes are excluded). Takes effect immediately.
set.item.backup.dir.title: Backup directory
set.item.backup.dir.help: Directory where daily backups are stored (preferably on a separate drive). Leave empty to disable automatic backups.
set.item.backup.at.title: Daily backup time
set.item.backup.at.help: Host local time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Pick a quiet hour.
set.item.backup.keepDays.title: Backup retention (days)
set.item.backup.keepDays.help: Backups older than this many days are pruned (the latest backup is always preserved). Applied during the next backup run.
set.item.retention.endedDays.title: Cleanup after work ends (days)
set.item.retention.endedDays.help: Prune machine code copies and host artifacts after work ends, and worker diagnostics after each round ends. Ledger tasks, receipts, summaries, and statuses are always kept.
